name: mail-client
description: Trinity Mail transport client: provider-agnostic sendMail() over the shared relay, with a durable outbox (at-least-once retry + dead-letter), idempotency, message-contract headers, plaintext autogen, rate-limit + consent guardrails, and a console dev driver
postMessage: Installed to src/mail. 1) Copy .env.example into your env (governed via `npx @trinity369/use mail-tresor`); keep MAIL_DRIVER=console until you have relay credentials. 2) Apply outbox/schema.sql to your database. 3) Run the durable worker: `npx tsx src/mail/adapters/standalone-worker.ts` (or call mail.drain() after send in serverless). 4) Add mail-templates (rendering), mail-webhook (delivery events + suppression), and mail-dns (DNS). Tests: `npx vitest run src/mail`.
